run_diatomic_curve: run the diatomic potential energy curve test for omol or omat tasks using a pretrained MLIP model
compute_diatomic_curve: compute relative energies across interatomic distances for a diatomic molecule using a predictor model
generate_plot: generate a PNG plot of a diatomic potential energy curve with distance and relative energy axes
get_model: load a pretrained MLIP predictor model from a name or path for energy prediction on CUDA
combined_plot: generate a combined PNG plot overlaying multiple diatomic potential energy curves on a single figure
